profile.name: Modbus TCP服务器
profile.description: 这是一个基于网络的 Modbus TCP 服务器组件，不对应特定厂商的实体仪器。它通常用于实验室自动化系统中提供或模拟 Modbus 通信接口，使上位机、PLC 或测试程序能够与实验设备进行寄存器级数据交换与联调。
profile.description_en: This is a network-based Modbus TCP server component rather than a specific physical instrument from a known manufacturer. It is typically used in laboratory automation to provide or simulate a Modbus communication interface so that host software, PLCs, or test systems can exchange register-level data with laboratory equipment during integration and testing.

registry.name: Modbus Server
registry.description: Modbus Server是由Modbus (Open Standard)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、写入数据、启动、设置、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, add pack等操作。
